title: Frankfurt
sideASummary: Player deck back. No printed text.
sideBSummary: Frankfurt, blue, 50°6'39"N 8°40'56"E. Inland Europe map with a bullseye in the center. Compass with no anchor. No search box. The name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom. P4-08b.

rules: Second blue Player card for Frankfurt. Not a port. No search.
The bullseye in the map art is the city-card improvement slot. A card holds at most one improvement.
notes: Same coordinates as the search card: 50°6'39"N 8°40'56"E.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
